notes: ReturnToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Return (RETURN) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers have no fees or burns. There are no external mint, burn, administrative, or upgrade functions. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
